Definition: Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Melchizedek = "my king is Sedek"; 1) king of Salem and priest of the Most High God to whom Abram paid tithe after the battle he fought to free Lot; 'the order of Melchizedek' the order of the priesthood to which Christ belongs
